messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about International politics and organisations and Political behaviour and attitudes in Denmark, Germany, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, United Kingdom, Estonia, Hungary, and Slovenia during the 2000s, matching this research need: data on public satisfaction with how the European Commission is represented in selected EU member states
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Eurobarometer 2000s satisfaction way European Commission represents interests country survey dataset
GESIS Eurobarometer European Commission representation satisfaction 2005 2009 data
European Social Survey trust European Parliament European Commission 2000s dataset
action.query: Eurobarometer 2000s satisfaction way European Commission represents interests country survey dataset

queries: Flash Eurobarometer 197 satisfaction EC representation eleven member states 2006 dataset
GESIS ZA4456 flash eurobarometer 197 satisfaction representation European Commission
action.query: Flash Eurobarometer 197 satisfaction EC representation eleven member states 2006 dataset

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Flash Eurobarometer 197: Satisfaction with EC Representations in 11 Member States (2006)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4456","justification":"Excellent match. Conducted in October 2006, this survey specifically examines satisfaction with the European Commission's representations in 11 EU member states. It covers Denmark, Germany, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, the United Kingdom, Estonia, Hungary, and Slovenia. The survey includes 2,256 respondents drawn from influential professional groups, including journalists, politicians, teachers, and civil society representatives. It is particularly relevant for comparing perceptions of the European Commission's national representations. Important limitation: respondents are selected professional stakeholders rather than a representative sample of the general public."},{"title":"Flash Eurobarometer 176: Satisfaction Survey on the Representations of the European Commission in the Member States","url_or_doi":"https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/s1488_176","justification":"Excellent thematic match. This European Commission dataset directly investigates satisfaction with its representations in EU member states. Its geographic coverage includes Denmark, Germany, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, the United Kingdom, Estonia, Hungary, and Slovenia. It provides country-level survey materials suitable for comparative analysis of satisfaction with European Commission representation during the 2000s. Portugal is not explicitly listed in the catalogue's geographic coverage, so its inclusion should be verified. The survey's respondent population should also be checked before interpreting the findings as representative public opinion."},{"title":"Flash Eurobarometer 189a: EU Communication and the Citizens – General Public Survey (2006)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4453","justification":"Strong complementary dataset examining public attitudes toward communication between EU institutions and citizens. Conducted between September 25 and September 29, 2006, across the 25 EU member states at that time, including all 11 countries requested. Unlike surveys targeting professional stakeholders, this survey focuses on the general public. It is useful for investigating how citizens perceived EU communication and engagement, although it does not directly measure satisfaction with individual European Commission national representations."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 66.1: Public Opinion in the European Union (September–October 2006)","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/a1963ab6-0bfa-5965-9bd2-1b7b6a2662c3","justification":"Highly relevant complementary survey covering political attitudes, institutional trust, and perceptions of European integration across EU member states, including all 11 requested countries. It explicitly examines awareness of and trust in the European Commission, perceptions of EU institutions, access to information about the EU, and citizens' feelings of involvement in European affairs. Particularly valuable for comparing broader public attitudes toward the European Commission with satisfaction findings from Flash Eurobarometer 197."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 65.2: Public Opinion, European Constitution, and Social Issues (March–May 2006)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4506?lang=en","justification":"Relevant cross-national public opinion dataset from 2006, covering the requested EU member states. It examines attitudes toward European integration, political participation, the European Constitution, and broader social and political issues. It can provide contextual measures of public confidence and support for European institutions when analyzing satisfaction with the Commission's representation. It is a complementary source rather than a direct measure of satisfaction with national Commission offices."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 67.2: Standard Eurobarometer 67 (2007)","url_or_doi":"https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/s617_67_2_std","justification":"Relevant follow-up dataset from 2007, providing comparative public opinion information across European Union member states. Its country-level and demographic breakdowns support analysis of national differences in attitudes toward European integration and institutions. It can help contextualize satisfaction with the European Commission's representation after the 2006 surveys and explore broader patterns of public confidence in EU governance. It does not specifically measure satisfaction with Commission representation offices."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 58.0: Public Opinion in the European Union (September–October 2002)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA3692?lang=en","justification":"Useful historical comparison dataset covering public attitudes toward EU membership, European institutions, political discussions, and European integration in 2002. It provides an earlier baseline for several of the requested countries. However, Estonia, Hungary, and Slovenia had not yet joined the EU in 2002, so this survey cannot provide full comparable coverage of all 11 countries. Best used for examining longer-term changes in public attitudes in countries that were already EU members."}]}
